item.title: California Bans AI‑Only Layoffs, Grants Worker Rights
item.description: California's new law bars employers from using AI as the basis for firing or disciplining staff, bans bathroom surveillance, and demands transparency.

item.title: Norway Considers Ban on AI‑Enabled Smart Glasses
item.description: Norway’s digital minister proposes strict limits on camera‑enabled wearables, targeting AI‑driven facial recognition and privacy‑invasive smart glasses.
